description: Knowledge pack reconstructed from JSP 815 Defence Safety Management System V1.3 (Ministry of Defence, Open Government Licence v3.0): the SMS Framework, all 12 Elements with their Expectations and Performance Statement themes, and Annexes A to F plus H. Covers the Defence Safety Function and which JSP applies, leadership and safety culture, organisation and SEMS applicability, legislation and exemption certificates, risk assessment and safety cases, supervision and contracting, competence and letters of delegation, equipment and infrastructure safety, performance and incident management, and assurance, audit, and the ISO 45001 clause mapping. SCOPE LIMITS: single-source (JSP 815 V1.3 with Annex H V1.2); carries no DEF-STAN 00-051 or DEF-STAN 00-970 content, no JSP 375, JSP 816; acquisition safety policy is in jsp-376, no Annex G (Assurance Toolkit), and no ISO 45001 text (clause numbers only). This pack is reconstructed reference notes, not MOD guidance, and has no official status.
